assessment-without-evidence.message: A supported or exception outcome must cite at least one evidence record.

breach-claimed-at-termination-second.message: A breach must be reported by a finding.

breach-claimed-for-unterminated-owner.message: A breach must be reported by a finding.
breach must say whether the account owner's termination took effect before this use.

breach-declared-no.message: A leaver-access outcome is exception exactly when some account was used after its owner's termination.

change-approved-after-deployment-declare.message: breach must say whether the change lacked independent approval before deployment.

dangling-evidence.message: Cited evidence is older than the engagement's maximum evidence age at its as-of time.
Cited evidence must be collected no later than the assessment.
Cited evidence must be of a type the assessed control accepts.

evidence-not-collected-for-engagement.message: Cited evidence must come from a collection in the same engagement.

evidence-type-not-accepted.message: Cited evidence must be of a type the assessed control accepts.

exception-without-breach.message: A change-approval outcome is exception exactly when some privileged change lacked independent prior approval.

finding-on-supported-assessment.message: A finding must be based on an assessment whose outcome is exception.

finding-without-approved-review.message: A finding's basis assessment needs an approved review.

missing-exception-finding.message: A breach must be reported by a finding.

review-after-as-of.message: A review cannot be recorded after the engagement's as-of time.

review-before-assessment.message: A review cannot be recorded before the assessment it reviews.

review-with-two-reviewers.message: A review needs exactly one reviewer and one reviewed assessment.

reviewer-is-assessor.message: The reviewer must not be the assessor of the reviewed assessment.

self-approved-change-declared-no.message: breach must say whether the change lacked independent approval before deployment.

stale-evidence.message: Cited evidence is older than the engagement's maximum evidence age at its as-of time.

supported-despite-breach.message: A leaver-access outcome is exception exactly when some account was used after its owner's termination.

unsupported-finding.message: A violation must reference a fact whose breach is yes.

use-outside-period.message: An account use must fall within the engagement period.
